# Version 4.156.0 (Unreleased)
> **Skia m156 platform support**

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.156.0 updates to Skia m156 and expands GTK4, Tizen, and .NET 11 support. The release restores Linux system-font discovery for NoDependencies deployments and adds GTK4 OpenGL drawing support with high-DPI scaling.

## Breaking Changes

*None in this preview line.*

## Engine

- **Skia updated to milestone m156** — Aligns the bundled renderer with Skia m156 and incorporates the m155 core fork cleanup. ([#5247](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5247), [#5208](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5208))

## API Surface

- **GTK4 OpenGL drawing support** — Adds GTK4 OpenGL drawing integration and high-DPI-aware rendering for applications using SkiaSharp.Views.Gtk4. ([#5249](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5249))

## Bug Fixes

- **Linux NoDependencies font discovery restored** — Restores system-font discovery on Linux for applications that use the NoDependencies native assets. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#5086](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5086))

## Platform

- **.NET 11 WebAssembly native assets aligned** — Aligns WebAssembly native-asset packaging and package-consumer validation with the .NET 11 preview toolchain. ([#5306](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5306))
- **Tizen 10 native packages updated** — Updates the Tizen native build and package configuration for Tizen 10 with GCC 14.2. ([#5235](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5235))
